If your issue also involves crashing in OpenGL, it's likely a different problem.

* In which versions of Godot *4.3.stable*, *4.4.stable*, *4.4.1.stable*, *4.5.dev1*?
* Are you using any specific features, like [Reflection probes](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/tutorials/3d/global_illumination/reflection_probes.html) or plugins?
* In `Godot_*_console.exe` with verbose, does it return any error?

Ah, nope! I just ran another batch of bisecting and it landed on the same commit.

PR: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/103348

Also tested commit right before it, and both projects ran fine (I was accidentally testing the commit AFTER in my above comment...)

Ah! So, interesting - when testing originally, I was running my 2080 TI with driver version 457.51 - I just updated to the newest studio driver (572.83) and it looks like I can now run the project fine in 4.4.1 with Vulkan.

@brcontainer - are you using the newest studio drivers for your 1050 Ti ?
